source: OpenStreetMap native palace boundary and building footprints
axis: Positive X crosses the palace toward the east. Positive Z follows the long palace sides toward the southern entrance.
identityStatus: Named Kyoto Imperial Palace enclosure with independent footprints and shared control points at the perimeter gates.
notes: The named native enclosure and the building and roof ways within it establish the mapped compound. The six outer gates and the three principal ceremonial gates have separate controls. Wall segments and roof sections may include overlapping native roof and wall projections.

terrainContact.basis: Original field in the ceremonial South Garden between Shishinden and Shomeimon.
